title: Trump offered to sell arms to China: US ambassador to Fox News

blocks.text: WASHINGTON — US President Donald Trump offered to sell arms to Beijing in response to concern over weapons sales to Taiwan, the US ambassador to China said in a Fox News interview that aired Sunday. China claims Taiwan is part of its territory, and US arms sales to the self-ruled island have long been a thorny issue between Washington and Beijing. The United States is required by law to supply Taiwan, which has a democratically elected president and legislature, with weapons for its defense.
